title: Meiosis
short_description: Meiosis is an Agentic SCM that provides a zero-trust runtime containment layer for AI coding agents. It actively intercepts file edits in real time to enforce strict scope boundaries, cryptographically audit every agent-generated change, and require verified test evidence before code is accepted.
